# Generation boundary

This file lists hand-maintained inputs the generator copies verbatim into the generated client output. These are not generated from the spec and must not be overwritten by regeneration.

## Android Gradle wrapper

The following files are committed here and copied into `clients/android/` during generation:

```
gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties
gradlew
gradlew.bat
```

**Why:** The wrapper JAR is a binary and cannot be generated by an agent. The wrapper files are identical across all standard Android projects and are resolved at build time by the Gradle toolchain. Including them as a committed template means evaluators need only a JDK (not a system Gradle installation) to regenerate and build the project. See `spec/platform/android.md` K1.3.

**Wrapper version:** Gradle 8.x update `gradle-wrapper.properties` to pin the exact version when A02 is run.
